name: Trusts Issuer
description: An AWS IAM OIDC provider registers trust in an OIDC issuer — its configured URL is that issuer's canonical host. An AWS -> issuer fact, so aws_core owns the edge type. Derived link (not hotlink-backed): the provider is written by aws_core but this edge is resolved during github_core's enrichment phase by matching aws_iam_oidc_provider.url against identity_core__oidc_issuer.host, because github_core is the plugin that today runs a grid-link engine and mints the issuer singleton in the same run. Converges the AWS federation path onto the same issuer node Sigstore identities are vouched by.
